# nlohmann JSON

The unmodified single header is from upstream tag v3.12.0, licensed under the MIT
license included here. It is used only for configuration and CLI result serialization;
the ISA and transition libraries do not depend on it.

- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0
- Header SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`
- License SHA-256: `46a65cffd1ea955132d95a8dd921640714a8d6b537d2e4e482d31145ae95b603`

The dependency provides maintained standard C++ JSON parsing and serialization.
Vendoring this exact release permits offline builds after SystemC is provisioned.
